verdict.rationale: OCI documents that its CLI provides the same core functionality as the Console plus additional commands. That CLI sits on standard REST APIs, with SDKs and a Terraform provider for programmatic management. The word "core" hedges the parity claim, and account upgrade is documented only as a Console action. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of full API/UI parity, evidence that account and billing actions like upgrading to paid can be done via API, a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
